title: PR #28: refactor: introduce deterministic Rust core for atc-dex
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

Adds a Rust-first deterministic DEX core using integer u128 arithmetic, deterministic order-book tie-breaking, checked constant-product swaps, and explicit settlement timestamps. The existing TypeScript surface remains untouched for now; this PR establishes the audited core before removing the JS compatibility layer.
